description: MainActivity.kt for an Android Tic-Tac-Toe game, implementing UI interactions and game logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the Tic-Tac-Toe game UI and logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: setupBoard
methods.description: Configures the game grid, initializes the board state, and sets click behavior for cells.

methods.name: updateTurnDisplay
methods.description: Updates the display to indicate which player's turn it is.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board and UI to start a new game.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Starts a new game, resetting the board and variables.

methods.name: switchPlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player between 'X' and 'O'.

methods.name: checkWin
methods.description: Checks if the current player has won the game.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game has ended in a draw.

methods.name: aiMove
methods.description: Performs an AI move by selecting the first available cell.
